# FIGS

> > FIGS designs and sells premium medical scrubs, uniforms, and healthcare apparel for professionals seeking style and functionality.

FIGS is a leading designer of medical apparel offering a comprehensive range of scrubs, lab coats, and loungewear with proprietary fabric technologies. The site features curated collections for women including best-selling styles, new arrivals, and collaborations with brands like New Balance.

## Key Topics

- Medical scrubs
- Healthcare uniforms
- Women's apparel
- Scrub tops
- Scrub pants
- FIONx™ fabric technology
- FORMx™ fabric technology
- THE SET
- Catarina One-Pocket Scrub Top
- Rafaela Oversized Scrub Top
- Zamora Jogger Scrub Pants
- ScrubJumpsuits™
- ScrubLeggings™
- Lab coats
- Off-Shift™ loungewear

## Women's Scrubs Collections

- [Women's Scrubs - Premium Medical Uniforms & Apparel](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/all-scrubs-womens): Complete women's scrubs catalog including tops, pants, and lab coats.
- [Women's New Arrivals](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/new-arrivals-womens): New women's scrubs including Catarina and Zamora products with latest designs.
- [Women's New Customer Favorites](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/new-customer-favorites-womens): Best-selling women's scrubs curated for new customers including THE SET.
- [Women's Awesome Today Gone Tomorrow](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/atgt-womens): Clearance collection of previously launched women's scrubs at discounted prices.

## Scrub Tops & Bottoms

- [Women's Scrub Tops](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/scrub-tops-womens): Women's scrub tops collection featuring Catarina, Casma, Rafaela styles.
- [Women's Scrub Pants](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/scrub-pants-womens): Women's scrub pants in skinny, straight, and jogger styles with color options.
- [Women's Scrub Sets](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/scrub-sets-womens): Coordinated women's scrub sets featuring THE SET best-seller collection.

## Specialty Scrub Products

- [Women's ScrubJumpsuits™](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/scrubjumpsuits-womens): Women's ScrubJumpsuits including Rafaela Cargo style medical apparel.
- [Women's ScrubLeggings™](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/scrubleggings-womens): Women's ScrubLeggings with Ashland styles offering professional legging wear.
- [Women's FIONx™ Scrubs](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/fionx-fabric-womens): Women's FIONx scrubs with moisture-wicking and anti-wrinkle technology.
- [Women's FORMx™ Scrubs](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/formx-scrubs-womens): Women's FORMx ultra-stretchy scrubs collection with sleek modern designs.

## Layering & Outerwear

- [Women's Jackets and Vests](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/jackets-and-vests-womens): Women's jackets and vests with ContourKnit and fleece layering options.

- [Women's Lab Coats](https://www.wearfigs.com/collections/lab-coats-womens): Women's Bellevue lab coats in slim and classic styles with custom options.
